---
title: "Blog"
page-layout: full
include-before-body: ../assets/html/particles-embed.html
include-after-body: ../assets/html/particles-scripts.html
listing:
  # Portuguese twin of index.qmd — see the note there for why this is a separate
  # file instead of two when-profile blocks.
  #
  # Deliberately no `output-file: index.html`: that makes two sources target the
  # same output, which `quarto render` tolerates (it honours the `!` exclusion in
  # each profile's render list) but `quarto preview` does not — preview ignores the
  # exclusion, renders both, and dies on the rename collision. build.ps1 renames
  # this to blog/index.html inside the pt tree instead.
  id: blog-listing
  contents: "[0-9]*.qmd"
  exclude:
    pt-version: true
  type: grid
  categories: true
  sort: "date desc"
  fields: [title, description, categories, date]
toc: false
---

::: {.page-intro}
Uma coleção crescente de exercícios de economia quantitativa. Replicações e extensões
de trabalhos empíricos públicos de bancos centrais, artigos acadêmicos e pesquisa
primária, construídos sobre dados públicos.
:::

:::{#blog-listing}
